claim: Piedmont holds 3 three-star, 2 two-star, and 29 one-star restaurants in the Michelin Guide Italy 2026
quote: Piedmont has 34 restaurants (3 Three Stars, 2 Two Stars and 29 One Star)

claim: Piazza Duomo in Alba is led by Enrico Crippa in partnership with the Ceretto family and holds 3 Michelin stars
quote: Piazza Duomo is the culinary kingdom of the Ceretto family, pioneers of the Langhe-Roero regions, and of Chef Enrico Crippa, 3 solid Michelin stars

claim: Piazza Duomo is at Piazza Risorgimento 4 in Alba, open Wed-Sat for lunch and dinner
quote: Piazza Risorgimento 4, Alba (CN); Wednesday-Saturday: Lunch 12:30-1 PM; Dinner 7:30-8:30 PM

claim: Piazza Duomo offers five tasting menus: The Journey (8 courses), Seasonal Things (11 courses), Barolo, Art Bites (lunch-only 4 courses), and White Truffle (Oct-Dec)
quote: The Journey, Seasonal Things, Barolo, Art Bites (lunchtime only), Alba White Truffle (October–December)

claim: Piazza Duomo tasting menus start from €290; reservations open on a specific date at 10am Italy time for an entire month at once
quote: The restaurant releases all reservations for the entire month at once at 10AM Italy time; no-show fee €290 per cover

claim: La Rei Natura is the restaurant of Il Boscareto Resort & Spa in Serralunga d'Alba, led by chef Michelangelo Mammoliti
quote: La Rei Natura – Il Boscareto Resort, Serralunga d'Alba, Langhe, Piedmont

claim: La Rei Natura tasting menus are priced at €280-350; wine pairings €100-250; white truffles are €12 per gram as an add-on
quote: Tasting menu €280 (classic or game-focused) or €350 (10-course blind MAD100%Natura); wine pairing €100-250; truffles 12€/gram

claim: La Rei Natura seats 35 guests; chef Mammoliti grows herbs in a 200m² on-site greenhouse and a vegetable garden in Barolo
quote: 35 guests; 200-square-metre greenhouse visible from the resort entrance, plus an additional vegetable garden in Barolo

claim: Antica Corona Reale in Cervere holds 2 Michelin stars; tasting menus start from ~$131/€120; chef Gian Piero Vivalda won the Passion Dessert Award 2024
quote: 2 Michelin stars; Tasting Menu starting from $131; Passion Dessert Award 2024

claim: Antica Corona Reale was founded in 1815 and has been run by the Vivalda family for five generations; serves traditional Piedmontese cuisine with French accents
quote: recently celebrated its 200th anniversary under the stewardship of the Vivalda family across five generations

claim: Locanda del Sant'Uffizio gained its second Michelin star in November 2022; chef Gabriele Boffa was born in Alba and trained internationally
quote: Second Michelin star: November 2022 (2023 Guide); born in Alba in 1987

claim: Locanda del Sant'Uffizio is set in a converted 17th-century monastery in Cioccaro di Penango and celebrates Italian biodiversity inspired by Monferrato tradition
quote: two Michelin stars; cuisine celebrates Italian biodiversity while remaining faithful to the territory

claim: Antica Corona Reale is approximately 25 km from Alba in Cervere; Piazza Duomo tasting menu around €180 for a basic option
quote: Antica Corona Reale (Cervere, 25km from Alba); Piazza Duomo price €180

claim: Serralunga d'Alba is approximately 15 km and 14 minutes by car from Alba
quote: road distance 9.5 miles (15.3 km); approximately 14 minutes drive from Alba to Serralunga d'Alba
